name: spt-fika
description: SPT server backend. Fika-compatible, but must be installed and configured. This is a barebones template to get your SPT/Fika server running quickly on Unraid.

paths.name: Server User Directory
paths.description: Location of user profiles, server mods (user/mods), and logs.

ports.name: Web / Client Port
ports.description: Host port for client HTTP traffic (used when running on bridge network).

variables.name: Bind IP
variables.description: Internal bind address inside the container.

variables.name: SPT Port
variables.description: Internal listening port for the SPT server.

variables.name: Backend Advertised IP
variables.description: Advertised LAN/remote IP address that game clients use to connect to this server.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file permissions (99 is Unraid 'nobody', 1000 for standard Linux user).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file permissions (100 is Unraid 'users', 1000 for standard Linux group).
